title: A person who paid online when joining still shows "Not paid yet" on Enquiries, and Add as member there lets the desk charge them again
what: On the Enquiries page, every online join request says "Not paid yet.", because the gym server always saves it as unpaid; the real online payment is kept elsewhere. Add as member on that page opens Sell membership with the whole fee due, does not close the person's open payment link, and gives no warning. Only Today's Joined online card checks the payment and offers Approve. So the desk can take the fee in cash from someone who already paid online, and the person can still pay online after paying at the desk. The money check later says "They may have paid twice".
expected: The Enquiries row says Paid online when the payment company confirmed it, and Add as member on a join request does what Today's card does: close open payment links first, and send a paid request to Approve instead of a second sale.
who: owners, front desk and members who join online
how_often: every online join paid online that the desk opens from Enquiries instead of Today
fix_line: Read the join payment on the Enquiries row and route Add as member through the same checks as Today's card

title: A person who asked to join online at one price is sold the plan at today's price when the desk taps Make member
what: The join request row shows the price the person saw and agreed to on the join page. When the desk taps Make member (from Today or Enquiries), Sell membership opens on that plan but fills in the plan's current price, not the agreed one. If the owner changed the price in between, the member is charged a different amount with no warning. Approve after an online payment does use the agreed price, so the two ways disagree.
expected: Make member opens Sell membership with the price and joining fee the person agreed to on the join page, or says plainly that the price has changed since.
who: members who join online, front desk
how_often: only when a plan price changes between the request and Make member
fix_line: Pass the agreed price and joining fee into Sell membership, or warn when they differ

title: Cancelling a receipt the member paid online says nothing about giving the money back
what: Cancel receipt on a member page says only that the receipt will no longer count as money received and the amount goes back on their dues. For a fee the member paid online through the gym's payment company, the money is still in the gym's account, and nothing tells the owner to refund it there. The member then shows as owing a fee they already paid, and the money check treats that payment as already saved, so it never comes up again.
expected: For a receipt paid online, the cancel sheet says the money stays with the gym until it is refunded at the payment company, so the owner refunds it or keeps the receipt.
who: owners and members who paid online
how_often: each time an owner cancels a receipt that was paid online
fix_line: Add one line to the cancel sheet for online-paid receipts saying to refund at the payment company

title: The Plan ending WhatsApp asks the member to pay for a plan the gym no longer sells
what: The ready-typed Plan ending and Plan ended messages on a member page give the renewal price and a UPI pay link for the member's current plan. They use that plan even after the owner switched it off. The desk cannot sell a switched-off plan, so the member is asked to pay an amount the desk will not accept for that plan.
expected: When the member's plan is no longer sold, the message leaves out the price and pay link, or uses the plan the desk would sell instead.
how_often: for members whose plan was switched off
fix_line: Skip the renewal amount when the member's plan is no longer active
